# NowServingTO

> A daily-fresh directory of restaurants newly licensed in Toronto, classified
> by cuisine and district. Sourced from the City of Toronto's Municipal
> Licensing and Standards open data, verified open via Google Places and
> web search, updated every morning around 1:17 AM Toronto time.

The site is intended for people looking for the newest restaurants of a
specific cuisine or neighbourhood. The full data is the City of Toronto's
licence feed for the past 365 days, filtered to entries confirmed as
operating, classified by AI (Anthropic Claude) into ~50 cuisine buckets,
and rendered as static HTML.

## Browse

- [Home](https://nowservingto.com/): Newest restaurants across Toronto, top 30
- [Sitemap](https://nowservingto.com/sitemap.xml): All 500+ pages
- [Press kit](https://nowservingto.com/press): Methodology, screenshots, contact

## Cuisines

Every cuisine has its own page at `/cuisine/<slug>` listing the newest
restaurants of that cuisine, ordered by licence-issue date. Each page
includes JSON-LD `CollectionPage` markup with a `sameAs` link to the
Wikidata entity for that cuisine.

Examples:
- [Italian](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/italian)
- [Chinese](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/chinese)
- [Indian](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/indian)
- [Vietnamese](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/vietnamese)
- [Mexican](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/mexican)
- [Ethiopian](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/ethiopian)
- [Filipino](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/filipino)
- [Tibetan](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/tibetan)
- [Tamil](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/tamil)
- [Guyanese](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/guyanese)

The complete list of cuisines lives in `sitemap.xml`.

## Districts

Toronto is divided into six districts. Each has a page listing the newest
restaurants in that area:

- [Downtown](https://nowservingto.com/district/downtown)
- [East Toronto](https://nowservingto.com/district/east-toronto)
- [West Toronto](https://nowservingto.com/district/west-toronto)
- [North York](https://nowservingto.com/district/north-york)
- [Scarborough](https://nowservingto.com/district/scarborough)
- [Etobicoke](https://nowservingto.com/district/etobicoke)

## Individual restaurants

Each restaurant has a detail page at `/r/<slug>` with its address, cuisine,
how recently it was licensed, a thumbnail, and links to its website +
Google Maps card. JSON-LD `Restaurant` markup includes `geo`, `address`,
`servesCuisine`, `aggregateRating` (when available), `foundingDate`
(licence date), and `hasMap`.

## How data is sourced

- **Licence data**: City of Toronto Open Data, Municipal Licensing and
  Standards, "Business Licences" dataset (refreshed daily).
- **Cuisine classification**: Anthropic Claude Haiku, given the operating
  name and address; verified with web search for ambiguous cases.
- **Operating verification**: Google Places API (one-time enrichment) plus
  ongoing web-search re-verification on tier-aware intervals.
- **Chain filter**: Hand-curated denylist of known American/Canadian
  chains; anything matching is excluded regardless of AI verdict.

## What this site is not

- Not user-submitted reviews. The source of truth is the City's licence
  feed, not user input.
- Not a tourist guide to "ethnic food" — the audience is people from
  specific diaspora communities looking for the newest spot in their cuisine.
- Not historical archive. Only restaurants licensed in the past 365 days
  appear; older licences fall out automatically.
